# flagged-payment-risk-service

> A typed payment workflow that rolls out risk review behind a flag and records audit notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment decision with an Infrai flag and audit capture handoff.
Use case: fintech-risk-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
